headings.styles: Used for the Main Title, Score, and Countdown Timer. Apply subtle text-shadow to create a glowing neon effect. DO NOT exceed text-4xl on mobile for headings to prevent layout breaking.

body.styles: Used for Questions, Answers, Explanations, and Usernames. Clean and readable monospace font to match the 'tech' vibe while remaining highly accessible.

visual_enhancers.borders: Thick pixel borders. Use standard Tailwind border-4 or unblurred box-shadow offsets to maintain the chunky arcade look. E.g., border-4 border-purple-500.
visual_enhancers.glow_effects: Use multiple layered text-shadows or box-shadows with increasing blur for neon depth. Example: drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.5)].
visual_enhancers.scanlines: Apply a subtle CSS pseudo-element over the main game container with repeating-linear-gradient to simulate CRT screen scanlines. mix-blend-mode: soft-light, opacity: 15%.
visual_enhancers.surface: Solid background for readability. NEVER use complete transparent background in any surface that has content under it.

grids_layouts.container: Center the game in a compact panel (max-w-2xl or max-w-3xl). The wrapper should use flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-screen.
grids_layouts.panel: A heavily styled 'arcade cabinet' screen panel. Needs generous internal padding (p-6 to p-12) to prevent text collision and maintain breathing room.
grids_layouts.question_screen: Stack layout: Header (Score & Timer), Question Box, 2x2 Grid for Answer Buttons (on md+ viewports) and 1 column stacked on mobile.

button.default: Chunky, solid border (border-4 border-purple-500/40), bg-[#0B1020], text-white. Font: Fira Code.
button.hover: Increase border opacity (border-purple-500), add box-shadow neon glow, slightly translate up (-translate-y-1).

timer.warning: When time < 10s, pulse animation and change Color: Electric Red (#FF003C).

panel_card.structure: border-4 border-cyan-500/50 bg-[#0B1020] shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(0,240,255,0.15)] rounded-none relative overflow-hidden

inputs.text: For username field: chunky input, border-2 border-purple-500 bg-transparent text-white focus:outline-none focus:border-cyan-500 focus:shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(0,240,255,0.5)] px-4 py-3

motion.buttons: Subtle scale up on hover. transition-transform transition-shadow duration-200. NO 'transition-all'.
motion.timer: Keyframe pulse animation for the final 10 seconds. 'animate-pulse'.
motion.screen_transition: Fade in on screen change (opacity transition over 300ms) to prevent jarring snap-cuts.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure Q&A text has minimum 4.5:1 contrast against panel backgrounds.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for timer pulses and transitions.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements MUST have visible focus states (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-cyan-500 focus:outline-none).

image_urls.instruction: Use as a deeply blurred (backdrop-blur-[100px] or opacity-20) full-screen background behind the main game panel to add atmosphere. Do NOT use as the direct background for text.

instructions_to_main_agent.tech_stack: React, Tailwind CSS. Use .js extensions for components (NO .tsx files).
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='username-input', data-testid='start-game-btn', data-testid='answer-button-0', data-testid='score-display').
instructions_to_main_agent.gameplay_logic: Local state only. 10 hardcoded questions. 30s timer per question. Show answer state (correct/incorrect) and explanation upon selection or timeout. 3 second delay before auto-advancing to the next question. Calculate total score at end.
instructions_to_main_agent.modularity: Structure components modularly (e.g., StartScreen, GameScreen, ResultScreen) so the design can be reused for a multiplayer version later.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and box-shadow glows (neon effect).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, click scales, transitions.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in any surface that has content under it.
